title: Render the intent anchor's verbatim request into every dispatch prompt
action:
Per D5 and D6 (plan.md, Approach, Half B): the user's verbatim request must ride every dispatch, and bee intent's existing anchor is the store it comes from. Today dispatch prepare reads no intent at all.

Step 1 - a feature-keyed, read-only anchor reader in intent_group.rs. The pieces already exist: intent_key_candidates (fn at intent_group.rs:107, pushes resolved-feature then session then DEFAULT_INTENT_KEY at :113-131), read_anchor_at (:216), read_intent (:229), and PRECOMPACT_HEADER (:250). Add ONE pub(crate) function that returns the verbatim request string for a dispatch: it tries the caller-supplied feature key first, then the active feature resolved from state, and returns None when neither yields a non-blank request. It MUST NOT fall through to DEFAULT_INTENT_KEY and MUST NOT consult the session key. That is the plan's answer to CONTEXT.md's deferred question 'how does a dispatch resolve WHICH intent anchor to read' - the evidence is in plan.md (Approach, Half B): read_anchor_at applies no TTL and no staleness check, and the live .bee/intent/default.json holds a four-day-stale request about unrelated work, so rendering it under a DO-NOT-PARAPHRASE header would be the exact drift D5 exists to prevent. Do not change intent set/show/advance/clear behaviour, and do not touch the compaction hook's own copy in hooks/compaction.rs.

Step 2 - call it from prepare.rs and add the var to BOTH arms. prompt_body_for is at drivers/prepare.rs:727. The non-cell arm builds a two-var slice at prepare.rs:758-761; the cell arm builds a nine-var slice at prepare.rs:779-789. Pass 2 of render (drivers/prompt.rs:103, second pass from :165) refuses any template var missing from its arm's slice, so original_request MUST be added to BOTH slices or every dispatch of the untouched kind dies at the door. For kind cell, pass the loaded cell's feature; for gather, reviewer and advisor, pass None and let the reader fall back to the active feature only. Render the value as the verbatim request wrapped in the existing PRECOMPACT_HEADER framing (intent_group.rs:250) - reuse that constant, never retype the header text.

Step 3 - the template block, in all four templates. Follow the two established conditional-block precedents exactly: the lane brief block at packages/bee/prompts/advisor.md:11-16 and the expertise block at gather.md:6-10, reviewer.md:6-10, advisor.md:6-10, worker-cell.md:28-32. Add the conditional original_request block to worker-cell.md, advisor.md, gather.md and reviewer.md, using the same if-block grammar those precedents use. The absent case must render byte-identically to today - the render engine consumes the block with its leading newline when the var is empty (prompt.rs:93, :118).

Step 4 - tests, in drivers/tests.rs beside the precedents. Judge existing coverage first, then author only the gap. Mirror no_brief_leaves_every_runtime_and_kind_pair_exactly_as_it_was (tests.rs:6641) and dispatch_prepare_without_expertise_renders_no_expertise_section (tests.rs:5431). Cover, from plan.md's test matrix: an absent anchor renders byte-identically for every runtime x kind pair; a present anchor appears verbatim in all four rendered prompts; a featureless gather/advisor dispatch renders NO block even when a non-empty .bee/intent/default.json exists (this is the load-bearing one); a request containing brace-brace and an if-block opener is not interpreted as template syntax; non-ASCII and Vietnamese text survives byte for byte; a whitespace-only request is treated as absent; corrupt or unreadable intent JSON degrades to no block and never fails the dispatch; and a template var absent from its arm's slice still fails loudly.

Step 5 - sync the two area specs named in affects_specs: dispatch.md gains the new prompt var and the feature-keyed-only resolution rule; the-intent-anchor-and-compaction-survival.md gains one line that the anchor now also reaches every dispatch, with the no-default-fallback reason. Prose only; keep each addition short and point at the other rather than repeating it.

Step 6 - packages/bee/prompts is a release-manifest root, so a prompt edit and a rebuilt manifest are one unit of work. Run the regen chain inside this cell, in this order: bee dev render-skill-trees, then bee dev install-support onboarding via bee onboard --repo-root . --apply, then bee dev release-manifest --write - or simply bee dev regen, which runs all three in that order. Commit the regenerated docs/history/codex-harness-hardening/release-manifest.json with the rest of the cell.

truths: A dispatch whose cell names a feature with an intent anchor renders that anchor's request verbatim, under the existing DO-NOT-PARAPHRASE header, in the worker prompt

With no anchor resolvable, every runtime x kind prompt is byte-identical to before this change
A request containing template syntax is carried as text, never interpreted
